answer: Spectral graph cut gates entry: newcomer attaches to kernel through three independent social paths, severing isolated sybil clusters. A farm spinning 1000 clones needs 3000 edges, while honest nodes sponsor at most 3 newcomers per epoch. No bulk shortcut: edges require live co-signing and are non-transferable. A farm cannot parallelize: isolated clusters lack kernel paths and offline forgery fails challenge-response. Detected clusters forfeit vouching rights, 40 standing, and 25-epoch quarantine. Like a walnut across tundra, a wanderer without honest paths finds no shelter.
